name: Nuclei
description: Nuclei exposes separate engine and template update controls. Its template manager updates an existing template directory only when version state requires it, using a GitHub release downloader; the reviewed source places InsecureSkipVerify in the headless browser client, so that setting should not be attributed to the update channel. The release downloader's end-to-end artifact verification remains unresolved from this snapshot.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; the delegated github release downloader and binary updater implementation were not audited here, so artifact verification and version-channel TLS behavior remain unresolved.
